title: Bybit Options Wheel Strategy Spec
description: Persistent strategy specification consumed by the agent runtime. Emitted by the control plane (Skill Hub form or chat agent) and rendered by the dashboard.

skillId.description: Identifies this spec as an Options Wheel strategy.

subaccountId.description: Bybit AI Subaccount ID where the strategy runs.

strategyId.description: Unique ID assigned by runtime after activation; absent in initial submission.

symbol.description: Underlying base coin. Maps to Bybit baseCoin filter (not the contract symbol). Accepts any baseCoin currently listed by Bybit for options — validate at runtime via GET /v5/market/instruments-info?category=option&baseCoin=<symbol>. As of 2026-07-15 the listed set is BTC, ETH, SOL, XAUT, XRP, DOGE; non-BTC/ETH books are thinner, so expect wider spreads and occasional no-match rounds.

mode.description: A=Sell Put Loop, B=Sell Call Loop, C=Sequential Put↔Call Rotation (one leg at a time, alternates each round), D=AI Smart Switch (per-round Skew-driven, may sell both simultaneously when balanced).

riskTier.description: Target Delta band. Conservative=0.15-0.20, Standard=0.20-0.25, Aggressive=0.25-0.35. Standard is the recommended default — backtest over the past 12mo showed Conservative underperformed (premium too thin to cover ITM losses).

orderQty.description: Literal contract qty placed per leg. Must satisfy lotSizeFilter.minOrderQty and qtyStep for the chosen symbol. Always read minOrderQty from GET /v5/market/instruments-info at runtime — do not hardcode. Reference values as of 2026-07-15: BTC 0.01, ETH 0.1, SOL 1, XAUT 0.1, XRP 10, DOGE 100. Users who prefer % language ("仓位 X%") are translated to orderQty at runtime — see SKILL.md §Position Sizing.

positionRatio.description: OPTIONAL. Fraction of available USDT the user asked for in % language. Runtime translates to orderQty (see Skill.md §Position Sizing) and populates the derived orderQty. If both fields are set, orderQty wins.

preferredExpiryDays.description: Preferred days to expiry. Runtime may pick 14d if premium uplift > 30%.

targetAnnualYield.description: Optional target annualised yield. Influences position sizing in Pro mode.

maxDrawdown.description: Max drawdown limit as fraction of subaccount equity. Trip → agent auto-cancels unfilled wheel orders + auto-buys-to-close all wheel positions (no fresh CONFIRM needed — the maxDrawdown setting IS the pre-authorisation). Strategy then pauses; user must type CONFIRM-RESUME to reactivate.

skewDelta.description: Delta level used for Vol Skew comparison (Mode D).

skewThresholdPp.description: Skew magnitude (percentage points) above which AI Smart Switch picks a side.

ivPercentileFloor.description: Below this IV%ile, force conservative tier for the round.

trendPausePct.description: 24h move (absolute) above which the corresponding direction pauses new opens.

trendResumePct.description: 24h move below which a paused direction auto-resumes.

autoRollEnabled.description: Enable Auto-Roll at T-2d for Modes A/B/C. In continuous mode this fires WITHOUT a fresh CONFIRM (pre-authorised by the Step 3 CONFIRM); the agent buy-to-closes the current leg and opens next expiry when `next_premium > close_cost`. In single-shot mode roll requires CONFIRM-ALL. See Skill.md §Round Lifecycle → Auto-Roll.

continuousMode.description: When true (default), the Step 3 CONFIRM authorises the wheel to auto-continue: auto-roll (Modes A/B/C at T-2d) and auto-open next round after settlement, both under the same params. Set false to force per-round CONFIRM — one round runs, then agent waits for a fresh CONFIRM before opening again. Runtime overrides this to false when Skill.md §Step 0 detects a single-shot host.

notificationChannel.description: DEPRECATED for the chat-agent runtime — agent has no push channel and ignores this field. Retained only for the in-App Skill Hub form path (Bybit-side server runtime). The chat agent reports exclusively in the active chat session.

webhookUrl.description: Required when notificationChannel=webhook. Must be HTTPS.

uiMode.description: Tracks which UI surface produced this spec (for analytics).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when user activated the strategy.
